spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. Containers use padding p-6 or p-8 to prevent collision.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Control Room style density.
spacing_and_layout.cards: Flat design, no drop shadows. Use bg-white with 1px solid border-slate-200. rounded-xl.
spacing_and_layout.navigation: Sidebar navigation (w-64) with Forest Green background (#064E3B). Top header for language switcher and mobile nav.

components.buttons: Flat, rounded-lg, slight translate-y on hover. Primary is Forest Green, Success actions are Vibrant Green.
components.inputs: Shadcn defaults customized with 1px border-slate-200, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent_success.
components.badges: Pill-shaped (rounded-full), soft background (e.g., bg-green-100) with dark text (text-green-800).

dashboard.description: Main Dashboard. Left col: Climate & Soil widgets. Center/Right col span: Profit Predictor Chart. Bottom: Pest Monitoring.
features: Dynamic Profit Predictor (Recharts, Hybrid Tomato vs Rice)
Gantt Chart/Timeline for Soil Prep, Planting, Harvest
Language Switcher (English, Tamil, Hindi, Spanish, Mandarin)

instructions_to_main_agent: Install dependencies: lucide-react, recharts, react-joyride, i18next, react-i18next, react-router-dom, framer-motion.
Set up global layout with a persistent Sidebar and Header (containing the Language Switcher using placeholder translations).
Initialize React-Joyride in the root App/Layout wrapper. Target elements using specific classes or IDs for the Navigation, Profit Graph, and Marketplace.
Use Recharts (LineChart) for the Dynamic Profit Predictor. Provide mock data for 'Hybrid Tomato' and 'Rice' toggles.
Build the Action Plan Gantt chart / Timeline strictly using HTML/CSS or a simple list if complex timeline is overkill, ensuring it remains highly responsive.
For the Marketplace, construct a robust e-commerce UI grid with standard filtering state (Category, Rating, Verified). Provide a placeholder Cart/Checkout state.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes formatted as kebab-case role-based names (e.g., data-testid='buy-button-tractor').
Strictly adhere to the Light Theme & Organic/Earthy archetype colors provided. No heavy gradients, just soft borders and tactile, earthy backgrounds.
